title: Cosmoscope
excerpt: A research assistant that turns a question into a map of concepts, with sources attached to every node.

data.text: The idea: you ask a question, say what quantum entanglement is, and instead of a paragraph you get a map. The concept in the middle, related topics around it, and on every node the sources it comes from, weighted by how reliable they are.
It interests me because a linear answer hides the structure of a topic, and the structure is what tells you where to go next. I sketched it with React Flow and a web search upstream.

image_captions: Cosmoscope interface with visual knowledge map and concept connections
